transcript.content: Hello. I'm a board-certified psychiatrist, and I'm here to help you today. What brings you in to see me?
I'm here because I've been struggling with a really low, depressed, and empty mood for about nine months now. I just feel constantly sad and hollow inside, and I can't seem to shake it.
Have you ever had periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the exact opposite—unusually energetic, happy, or hyperactive, and felt like you didn't need much sleep?

Yes, actually. Before this depression, I had a period of about eight months where I felt incredibly happy and overflowing with energy. I was constantly active and barely slept, but I never felt tired and didn't feel like I needed sleep at all.
During either your high-energy periods or your low periods, did you ever hear or see things that others couldn't, or have strong beliefs that others found unusual or untrue?

I haven't seen or heard things that aren't there, but I've definitely had some very intense beliefs. When I was feeling high, I truly believed I was a highly special person with a unique, important mission to fulfill. During my low periods, though, I felt an overwhelming guilt, believing I was somehow responsible for bad things happening that actually had nothing to do with me.
Did you ever experience these intense beliefs during times when your mood was completely normal, meaning you weren't feeling either unusually high or depressed?
I don't think so, no. I'm pretty sure those thoughts only happened when my mood was really high or really low. When my mood felt normal, I don't recall having any of those intense beliefs.
